newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says concerned with Iraqi developemnts.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says concerned with Iraqi developemnts.

text.p: Egypt on Tuesday expressed deep concern with the latest developments in Iraq after the United States launched cruise missile strikes against air defence targets in Iraq.

"Egypt is following with deep concern the current incidents on the Iraqi land and accompanied military movements and the use of force in north and south Iraq, increasing tension inside Iraq and the region and threaten civilian lives," the foreign ministry's spokesman said.
"Egypt underlines the importance of principles and goals of the U.N. charter, which guarantee Iraq's sovereignty, integrity and non-interference in its internal affairs," he added.

The United States on Tuesday launched cruise missile strikes in retaliation for last weekend's Iraqi military attacks that supported a Kurdish faction in its fight against another Kurdish group in northern Iraq.
"Egypt calls for full respect and implementation of the Security Council's resolutions," the foreign ministry's spokesman said.
